mapper.select: SELECT w.id_, w.svc_num, w.cust_name, w.developer_name, w.developer_id, w.prod_name, w.hq_svc_type, w.user_status, w.serv_manager_name, w.oa_name_dev, w.oa_id_dev, w.warning_info, w.new_scheme_name, w.new_create_date, w.new_exp_date, w.order_flow_no, w.open_date, w.area_name, w.county_id, dc.county_name AS county_name, c.user_status AS cycle_user_status, c.warning_info AS cycle_warning_info, c.cycle_flag FROM ftp_tc_user_common_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning c ON w.order_flow_no = c.order_flow_no LEFT JOIN dim_county_id dc ON dc.county_id = w.county_id WHERE w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} ORDER BY w.id_
